# OneXp SiteShot

> OneXp SiteShot is a free, developer-friendly website screenshot tool that captures full-page, device-accurate screenshots from any public URL. Export to JPG, PNG or PDF instantly — no installs, no watermarks.

## What it does

OneXp SiteShot lets users and developers capture website screenshots programmatically or via a simple web interface. It renders pages using a headless Chromium browser, supports desktop, tablet and mobile viewports, and returns clean screenshots in under 5 seconds for most websites.

## Key features

- Full-page screenshot capture (scrolls entire DOM)
- Device emulation: Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), Mobile (390px)
- Custom width and height support
- Export formats: JPG, PNG, PDF
- REST API with Bearer token authentication
- Rate limiting per plan (Free: 60/hr, Pro: 1,000/hr, Business: unlimited)
- No watermarks on any plan
- Beta: all features currently free

## Who it is for

- Web developers testing responsive designs
- QA engineers capturing page states for documentation
- Agencies archiving client websites
- Marketers capturing competitor pages
- Businesses automating visual monitoring

## Pricing

- Free: 100 screenshots/month, JPG only
- Pro: ₦1,500/month — 5,000 screenshots, JPG + PNG + PDF, API access
- Business: ₦2,500/month — unlimited screenshots, priority rendering, team accounts

All plans are currently free during beta while payment processing is finalized.

## API

Endpoint: POST https://siteshot.onexportalhq.com/api/v1/screenshot

Authentication: Bearer token (API key from dashboard)

Request body:
- url (string, required) — the website URL to capture
- width (number) — viewport width in pixels, default 1280
- height (number) — viewport height in pixels, default 1024
- fullPage (boolean) — capture entire scrollable page, default true
- format (string) — jpg | png | pdf, default jpg

Response includes: success, imageUrl, file (base64), meta (width, height, tookMs, format, fullPage)
